rga_fa18_inb.description: Residual current-dependence correction for Fa18 Inb. Stored value is epsilon_resid(I) = epsilon_data_rel(I) / epsilon_mc_rel(I), where epsilon_data_rel(I) = R_data(I)/R_data(0) from the DATA counts/nC fit and epsilon_mc_rel(I) = epsilon_mc(I)/epsilon_mc(0) from the MC rec/gen fit. Because cross_sections.cpp applies 1 / epsilon_resid(I), the cross section is multiplied by epsilon_mc_rel(I) / epsilon_data_rel(I), correcting the residual mismatch after current-dependent MC acceptance has already been applied. Data relative slope: -0.2537662628 +/- 0.0196421015 (% per nA). MC relative slope: -0.1579733848 +/- 0.0016897544 (% per nA). Intermediate values used: epsilon_data_rel(I) = 1 + slope_data * I / 100; epsilon_mc_rel(I) = 1 + slope_mc * I / 100; epsilon_resid(I) = epsilon_data_rel(I) / epsilon_mc_rel(I).
